content.text: Hizape guye neeni kawotethata kawiw geetetaka.
Taani ta asaa hanqetas; ta laata tunisas;
taani enta ne kushen aathada immas.
cimidaysata bolla ne deexo qambara wothadasa.
“Neno wopu gada uttidaarenne naagetada de7idaare si7a. Ne wozanan, ‘Taape attishin, hari baawa; taani am7o gidike; woyko yelada na7i bayna asi gidike’ yaagadasa.
Ha nam7ubati qoponna issi gallas ne bolla yaana. Ne bitay ay darikoka, ne murunnoy ay wolqaamikoka neeni ne naytape mela atteysinne am7etethay attenna.

content: “Neeni ne iitatethan ammanetada, ‘Oonika tana be7enna’ yaagadasa. Ne eratethaynne cincatethay nena balethin, neeni ne wozanan, ‘Taape attishin, hari baawa’ yaagadasa.
Shin neeni waatada ne bitan haassaneeko eronna iitay ne bolla yaana. Neeni gate qanxanaw danda7onna dhayoy ne bolla wodhana; qassi neeni aykoka qoponna gadoy ne bolla yaana.
“Ane neeni ne na7atethafe doomada oothashe de7ida ne bitaanne ne murunnuwa ha77ika ootha. Ooni eri ne qopidaysa mela hananeeko woyko neeni iyara daganthaneeko.
Neeni ekida zorey ubbay daabursafe attishin, nena aykoka maaddibeenna. Salo xoolinto taybeysatinne iya xeellidi ageenan ageenan hananaba odeysati ane nena asho.
Enti buure mela; tami enta maana. Enti tama lacuwape bantana ashshanaw danda7okona. Asi kayaa bonqoy woyko asi iya sinthan uttidi ho77iya tama gidenna.
Neeni entara daaburidaysati, na7atethafe doomidi neera zal7idaysati new hessa mela. Enti issoy issoy ba balan balan oyketana; nena ashshiya oonika baawa.”
